title: tac.engagements
description: Current engagements in a side's picture: every non-friendly track that is being engaged or has missiles in the air at it, and how many hostiles are unengaged. Needs the BDArmory binding in a flight scene (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE tactical_not_attached without it).

view.description: Picture to read: a team name (your own side unless you are a human, referee or director), or "god" for the truth (needs privilege or fog off). Defaults to the session's side.
